objective: Low-cost lightweight quadcopter streams live vision to the local drone137 harness and ground model; all AI remains on the ground.
status: Engineering build package plus camera-only firmware and ground receiver. Not an assembled, flight-ready or fully sourced kit.
price_status: Only camera and MTF-02P are manufacturer listings; other rows are allowances, not verified quotations. Sub-$50 procurement is unverified.
mass_status: Component allowances only. Target 60-85 g with battery and navigation pack; final mass and thrust margin must be measured.

basic_parts.part: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense with supplied camera and antenna
basic_parts.notes: Camera fitted by supplier may be OV3660 or OV5640; record sensor PID and focus result.
Verify genuine sensor, board pull-ups and supply pin; 3.3 V-compatible I2C required.

basic_parts.part: 8520 3.7 V brushed motors, matched CW/CCW pair sets
basic_parts.notes: 8.5 x 20 mm body, matching 1 mm prop shaft; exact winding/shaft SKU and thrust must be verified.
Two CW and two CCW, shaft fit to be confirmed.

basic_parts.part: 100 mm motor-diagonal frame with guards and 8.5 mm holders
basic_parts.notes: Parametric frame.scad is an unprinted prototype design; filament/fabrication allowance excludes labour.

basic_parts.part: 1S 450-600 mAh high-discharge LiPo with matched connector
basic_parts.notes: 4.2 V maximum; require measured current capability and sag margin, not only an advertised C rating.
Candidate low-side drivers. Bench thermal and stall-current tests required; no claim that package current rating is continuous board capability.
Candidate 3 A class clamp; select supplier datasheet and validate pulse/thermal stress.

basic_parts.part: 100 ohm gate resistors and 10 kohm gate pulldowns
basic_parts.notes: Four of each; keep motors off while processor resets.

basic_parts.part: Motor suppression and power decoupling capacitors
basic_parts.notes: 4 x 100 nF at motor terminals; 470 uF >=6.3 V at battery branch plus 47 uF and 100 nF near electronics. Confirm regulator stability.

basic_parts.part: Carrier PCB, IMU mounting and low-profile connectors
basic_parts.notes: Electrical connection specification supplied; routed PCB, Gerbers and assembly quote are not supplied.

basic_parts.part: Battery/motor wiring, strap, camera mount and fasteners
basic_parts.notes: Short rated wires and rigid forward-facing camera mount; no full-height pin headers in flight assembly.

basic_parts.part: Battery divider: two 100 kohm resistors and 100 nF filter
basic_parts.notes: VBAT through 100k to ADC, 100k from ADC to GND; filter to GND, calibrate with meter.

navigation_additions.part: MTF-02P optical flow and downward range sensor
navigation_additions.notes: UART sensor driver and estimator integration with the selected ESP firmware are required.
For MTF-02P only; 5 V output, at least 200 mA after transients. Do not connect to XIAO BAT pad.
Clear floor view and measured sensor orientation.

not_included: Ground PC and local Wi-Fi network

functional_limits.basic: Camera and stabilization development hardware; no demonstrated position hold or autonomous room search.
functional_limits.navigation: Adds local floor-relative sensing; requires a sensor driver, estimator and position reference. Not global room mapping or wall detection.

flight_firmware_status: ESP-Drone is a candidate basis, not a drop-in image for this carrier. The supplied Arduino camera image holds motor gates low and cannot fly.
